title: introduce-affordance-hints-and-release-teaser-generator-for-onboards
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: onboarding engineers often supply dense model metadata but downstream consumers (release notes, product pages, changelogs) need concise, audience-tailored summaries. This PR adds two complementary pieces: 1) a small, extensible 'affordance hints' field in the model metadata schema to capture human-friendly bullets about model behavior/intent; 2) a release-teaser generator that synthesizes one-line and short paragraph blurbs for release notes and changelogs from the model profile + affordance hints.

Scope and goals: keep the schema additive and backward-compatible, provide a lightweight CLI/CI hook to emit teaser drafts, and add a quality check that prevents 'empty' teasers for releases. This is not a full natural language rewrite engine — teasers are templated with optional heuristic rewriting for clarity. The generator supports two flavors: engineer (performance/cost/compatibility bullets) and product (high-level capability blurb).

What changed: added schema bump v2.3 with optional 'affordance_hints' array; implemented registry/hooks/release_teaser/generator.py with heuristic templates and short heuristics to collapse noisy profile stats; wired a CLI subcommand (cli/onboard_teaser.py) that can be invoked from onboarding pipelines; added CI integration (registry/ci/teaser_integration.yml) that runs the teaser generator against a sample onboarding bundle and fails if both teaser variants are missing or flagged as low-quality; tests added (registry/tests/test_teaser.py) and docs (docs/release-teaser.md).

Checklist: [x] schema add is additive and feature-flag guarded; [x] unit tests for template permutations; [x] CI hook added and smoke-tested; [x] performance profile impacts audited — teaser generation is CPU-only and <200ms per model on CI sample.

Backward compatibility: optional field only; registry will ignore affordance_hints when consuming older profiles. Migration path: onboard CLI will seed affordance_hints from existing profile notes when present.

Notes for reviewers: look at generator heuristics (generator.py) and the small whitelist for numeric summaries (we avoid raw token counts unless the profile indicates deviation from baseline). Also validate the release-teaser wording for non-technical audiences in docs/release-teaser.md.

review_thread: Jonah Kim (2026-02-15): Requested small changes to the numeric summarization rules — prefer relative deltas (p99 latency vs baseline) instead of raw token/runtime counts. Also asked to add a short circuit for models with missing performance profiles.
Ava Martinez (2026-02-15): Reply: added relative-delta heuristics in generator.py and a missing-profile fallback that emits "profile unavailable" teaser with a 'needs-profile' tag for reviewers.

Marco Alvarez (2026-02-16): Suggested adding a safety list to prevent claims like "state-of-the-art" unless explicitly flagged by model curation. I added a lightweight denylist and documented it in release-teaser.md.
Priya Singh (2026-02-18): Approved after CI pass and minor doc edits. Left an approval comment and asked the release team to decide whether product blurbs should be surfaced in the public changelog.
Ava Martinez (2026-02-18): Noted that product blurbs default to internal changelog only and require explicit opt-in for public exposure.

release_notes: Add optional 'affordance_hints' in model metadata (schema v2.3) to surface concise, human-friendly bullets about model behavior and intended use-cases.
Add release-teaser generator: produces short, audience-targeted blurbs for changelogs and onboarding summaries (engineer/product variants).
CI hook: teaser_integration workflow validates that onboarding bundles emit at least one non-empty teaser; prevents silent onboarding without release notes.
